proposed_urls.rationale: Gov Code Title 3 Subtitle A Ch. 305 (Registration of Lobbyists) - full lobbying-disclosure statute body, directory-level leaf.

notes: TX 2015 vintage available on Justia. Government Code title chosen at pass 1 (Election Code = campaign finance, intentionally excluded; Penal Code unrelated to lobbying disclosure). Tree is 5 levels deep: state -> code -> title -> subtitle -> chapter. Intermediate pass-2 fetches required at government-code/title-3/ and government-code/title-3/subtitle-a/. Compared with TX 2009 known-good which placed Ch. 305 under subtitle-c, TX 2015 places Ch. 305 under subtitle-a (Legislature) - subtitle reorganization confirmed by direct fetch (subtitle-c contains chapters 321-328 only). Pass-3 fetch on chapter-305/ returned an empty TSV, indicating it is a leaf directory page containing the full statute body (consistent with the TX 2009 directory-level full-chapter convention in example B of pass-2 prompt).
